name: Shenwan Hongyuan Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenwan Hongyuan Group Co., Ltd. provides various financial products and services to corporate, professional institutional, individuals, and non-professional institutional customers. It operates through four segments: Enterprise Finance, Personal Finance, Institutional Services and Trading, and Investment Management. The Enterprise Finance segment offers equity underwriting and sponsorship, debt underwriting and financial advisory, and debt and other investment services.
